primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: An adverse event (AE) was any untoward medical occurrence in a participant who received study drug without regard to possibility of causal relationship. A TEAE was defined as an AE that occurred or worsened on or after the first dose of ataluren and up to 4 weeks after the last dose of ataluren. A summary of other non-serious AEs and all SAEs, regardless of causality is located in the 'Reported AE section'.

groups.description: Participants received 3 doses of ataluren oral suspension per day (10 mg/kg in the morning, 10 mg/kg at midday and 20 mg/kg in the evening).
groups.title: Ataluren

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The As-treated population included all participants who received at least 1 dose of ataluren.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.timeFrame: Baseline up to end of study (up to approximately 15 years)
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Number of Participants With Treatment-emergent Adverse Events (TEAEs)
